robot: Tianji Marvin stand with two 7-joint arms and a Sharpa Wave dexterous hand (22 finger joints) on each wrist

frame.base_text: the Marvin stand origin (the floor point under its torso): +X the way the robot faces, +Y to its left, +Z up

right_hand.note: right Sharpa Wave finger joint targets (rad, 22, in the spec layout order: thumb CMC_FE, CMC_AA, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, IP; index, middle, ring MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP; pinky CMC, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP); no scalar gripper: grasp by closing the fingers on the object

right.note: right arm joints J1-J7 (rad); its measured hand-mount pose is reported as ee

left_hand.note: left Sharpa Wave finger joint targets (rad, 22, in the spec layout order: thumb CMC_FE, CMC_AA, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, IP; index, middle, ring MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP; pinky CMC, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP); no scalar gripper: grasp by closing the fingers on the object

resets.note: 20 resets in all (describe_robot resets.budget). Only the last episode is graded, and a success ends the run.

notes: Two 7-joint arms (parts left, right) and two hands (left_hand, right_hand), all joint positions: no end-effector pose command and no inverse kinematics; the measured hand-mount pose comes back as ee. The arm servos have no gravity compensation (a held target sags about 1 cm at the hand under load). A one-hand task keeps the other arm parked at its start targets. Every column is a position target (servo); grasping and carrying work only through contact. The parts follow the Sharpa Wave layout (describe_robot spec_file: hand "sharpa"). With the Wuji hand (hand "wuji", 20 finger joints per hand) the columns differ: use execute_trajectory space native with the order in spec action_types.joint_position.layout. Rows are 0.02 s apart or a multiple of it; a call covers at most 10 s. Measured poses are in the world frame of the task text, quaternions wxyz.
